summary: Cizzle Brands Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its November 2, 2026 press release announcing the French translation filing of its offering document for the Canadian portion of a previously announced underwritten public offering conducted under the listed issuer financing exemption, enabling Québec resident participation. Separately, a one-for-25 share consolidation takes effect November 5, 2026, pending final Cboe Canada approval, with post-consolidation shares trading under CZZL. Neither item constitutes a special situation; watch the offering close and post-consolidation trading dynamics.
